summary: Shoshone County, ID ground-level cabin lookout dated 1947 on the Coeur d'Alene NF, abandoned in the 1950s; listed as gone, with no current site description.

facts.design: Cabin at the northwest end of a ridge
facts.status_note: Abandoned in the 1950s and listed as gone; no source describes what remains at the site

events.note: Cabin, not a tower, at the northwest end of the ridge

corrections.proposed: Abandoned in the 1950s (no single year given)

notes_for_editor: Unresolved: the 1944 John McKay entry predates the 1947 cabin date given by two sources, and no source explains it. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page cites a news article without a link; we did not locate it. The brief's '1950 abandoned' is not supported; the sources say only the 1950s, so the event is written without a year. Site condition and public access are not described in any source read. No photos added.
